bacterial_spot.description: A bacterial disease affecting tomato leaves and fruits.
bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small dark spots with yellow halos on leaves.
bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seeds and avoid overhead watering.
bacterial_spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves and consult local agricultural experts about suitable copper-based products.

early_blight.description: A fungal disease caused by Alternaria species.
early_blight.symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings on older leaves.
early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops and avoid wetting leaves.
early_blight.treatment: Remove infected leaves and use locally recommended fungicides.

healthy.symptoms: Uniform green colour without visible disease spots.
healthy.prevention: Maintain proper watering, nutrition and field hygiene.
healthy.treatment: No disease treatment is indicated; continue regular monitoring.

late_blight.description: A serious disease caused by Phytophthora infestans.
late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions that may spread rapidly.
late_blight.prevention: Ensure good airflow and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.
late_blight.treatment: Remove infected material and seek locally recommended disease management.

leaf_mold.description: A fungal disease favoured by high humidity.
leaf_mold.symptoms: Yellow patches on upper leaf surfaces and olive-green growth underneath.
leaf_mold.treatment: Remove infected leaves and follow local fungicide recommendations.

mosaic_virus.description: A viral disease affecting tomato growth.
mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green leaves, sometimes distorted.
mosaic_virus.prevention: Use virus-free seeds and control weeds and insect vectors.
mosaic_virus.treatment: There is no curative treatment; remove infected plants where advised.

septoria_leaf_spot.description: A fungal leaf disease caused by Septoria lycopersici.
septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Small circular spots with grey centres and dark edges.
septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Remove plant debris and avoid overhead watering.
septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Remove affected leaves and follow local fungicide recommendations.

target_spot.description: A fungal disease caused by Corynespora cassiicola.
target_spot.symptoms: Brown circular lesions with concentric rings.
target_spot.prevention: Maintain spacing and avoid excessive leaf moisture.
target_spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves and consult an agricultural expert.

twospotted_spider_mite.description: A pest infestation caused by two-spotted spider mites.
twospotted_spider_mite.symptoms: Fine webbing, tiny pale spots and yellowing leaves.
twospotted_spider_mite.prevention: Monitor leaf undersides and manage weeds.
twospotted_spider_mite.treatment: Use locally approved mite-management methods and verify the pest before treatment.

yellow_leaf_curl_virus.description: A viral disease commonly transmitted by whiteflies.
yellow_leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Upward-curling yellow leaves and stunted growth.
yellow_leaf_curl_virus.prevention: Monitor whiteflies and use healthy planting material.
yellow_leaf_curl_virus.treatment: There is no curative treatment; manage whitefly vectors and seek agricultural advice.
